DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 105 s. 2021 August 20, 2021 HON. SUHARTO T. MANGUDADATU Governor Province of Sultan Kudarat Office of the Provincial Governor National Highway, Kalawag II, Isulan, Sultan Kudarat Dear Gov. Mangudadatu: This has reference to your letter dated 27 July 2021 requesting clarification as to which political party will the appointee to the resultant permanent vacancy in the Sanggunian Panlungsod after applying the rule on automatic succession pursuant to Section 44 of the Local Government Code (LGC). Based on your letter and its attachments, on 06 June 2021, the duly-elected Mayor of the City of Tacurong, Hon. Angelo O. Montilla, died thereby resulting to a permanent vacancy in his position. Pursuant to Section 44 of LGC, Vice-Mayor Lino O. Montilla assumed as Mayor while the first-ranking Sangguniang Panlungsod Member, Hon. Lallaine J. Montilla assumed as Vice-Mayor. Subsequent vacancies in the Sanggunian Panlungsod were filled up to fill the vacant positions resulting to one vacancy. However, you are in a quandary as to which political party will the appointee to the resultant permanent vacancy shall come from. In the landmark case of Navarro vs. Court of Appealsl, the Supreme Court ruled and has explained in detail that in case of death of a mayor, to wit: "The "last vacancy" in the Sanggunian refers to that created by the elevation of the member formerly occupying the next higher in rank in which in turn also had become vacant x x x. The term "last vacancy" is thus used in Sec. 45(b) to differentiate it from other vacancy previously created. The term by no means refers to the vacancy in the No. 8 position x x x. Such construction will result in absurdity." (Emphasis ours) 1 G.R. No. 141307, March 28, 2001. "Matino, Mahusat at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Thus, the "last vacancy" mentioned in Section 45 (b) of the LGC is neither the vacancy caused by the elevation of the Vice-Mayor to the Office of the Mayor nor the vacancy left by the last ranking Sanggunian member when he was elevated to the seventh- ranking position but rather it is that vacancy caused by the elevation of the first- ranking sangguniang member to the next higher rank. The Supreme Court ratiocinated that the reason behind the right given to a political party to nominate a replacement where permanent vacancy occurs in the Sanggunian is to maintain the party representation as willed by the people in the election. This Department believes that in electoral democracy, conscientious people may choose candidates not only because of their personal attributes and qualifications but also because oftheir political party affiliation. Accordingly, in the Navarro case, the political party nomination should be issued by the political party of the first-ranking Sanggunian member because he was the one who caused the last vacancy in the Sanggunian due to his elevation to the position of Vice-Mayor. Applying the foregoing, considering that Hon. Lallaine J. Montilla is the first-ranking Sangguniang Panlungsod Member who assumed as Vice-Mayor, then the appointee to the resultant vacancy should also come from her political party where she was elected, which, as represented, is from the Nacionalista Party (NP). Accordingly, per Section 45 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991, a nomination and a certificate of membership of the appointee from the highest official of the NPC are conditions sine qua non for the appointment to the resultant vacancy and any appointment without such nomination and certification shall be null and void ab initio and shall be a ground for administrative action against the official responsible therefor, thus: "SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. xxx (b) Except for the Sangguniang Barangay, only the nominee of the political party under which the Sanggunian member concerned had been elected and whose elevation to the position next higher in rank created the last vacancy in the Sanggunian shall be appointed in the manner hereinabove provided. The appointee shall come from the same political party as that of the Sanggunian member who caused the vacancy and shall serve the unexpired term of the vacant office. In the appointment herein mentioned, a nomination and a certificate of membership of the appointee from the highest official of the political party concerned are conditions sine qua non, and any appointment without such nomination and certification shall be null and void ab initio and shall be a ground for administrative action against the official responsible therefor." (Emphasis Supplied) Page 2 of 3

This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, B AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY GAN Unders cretary for Local Govemment OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/clp/OUSLG/ao DIRECTOR JOSEPHINE C. LEYSA DILG-Regional Office — XII Page 3 of 3
